name: forge-steward
description: Cross-agent skills for preparing and implementing repository work, reviewing changes, and resolving feedback.

plugins.name: check-workflow
plugins.description: Add missing workflow constraints while preserving existing project rules.

plugins.name: prepare-work
plugins.description: Prepare issues for implementation through investigation and issue updates; return only a single-line issue list.

plugins.name: execute-work
plugins.description: Implement a fixed issue list sequentially and submit independent change requests without merging.

plugins.name: review-and-merge
plugins.description: Review a frozen change-request queue and merge only fully eligible changes.

plugins.name: fix-feedback
plugins.description: Resolve required feedback and verified gaps on open change requests without merging.
